messages:
liam: quick thought about onboarding costs. instead of bench-on-every-commit, what if we do a rotating reservoir + hysteresis window to reduce churn?

zara: can you sketch the rotation semantics?

liam: idea: keep 3 reservoirs per model-family: fast-gold (20), long-tail (500), crc-hot (user-reported). daily rotate 10% of long-tail, always test full fast-gold on commit. only trigger heavy bench when hysteresis trips.

theo: define hysteresis. is it X windows or percentage change?

liam: propose two-layer hysteresis: short-window spike filter (3 10m windows) and sustained-drift (12h rolling). short spikes are ignored unless accompanied by correctness flips.

yuki: correctness flips meaning deterministic diffs on golden inputs? how tolerant are we to paraphrase/LLM noise?

liam: treat golden as structured checks (exact-match for canonical outputs, token-level normalized diff for free-text). we keep a fuzzy threshold for NLG where we compute a BLEU-like score and only block if below threshold AND accompanied by perf regression.

rob: operational note: we need an "escalate" signal for human review. auto-block for ABI failures; auto-canary for perf-only issues. escalate when golden flips or when user-reported samples fail.

liam: agreed. mapping: ABI -> fail fast; golden strict -> block; perf-only -> canary+throttle. escalate to triage when user-reported bucket shows regression.

zara: about storage: long-tail 500 per family * 1000 families = 500k rows. okay if compact. prefer newline-compressed rows with fields: model, commit, bucket, ihash, ohash, metrics. TTL 90d for long-tail, gold permanent.

theo: how do we backfill if a regression is discovered weeks later?

liam: keep reproducible seeds and input-hash store. backfill runs can reconstruct outputs using the saved seed + model artifact. we only need to persist input text + seed; outputs can be recomputed.

yuki: latency measurement caveat: p95 from cloud infra = noisy. recommend synthetic microbench on a fixed harness as part of bench, use live telemetry for secondary signal.

rob: make the bench queue budget-aware. small models get immediate slots; big models require token-budget approval or scheduled windows. prevents queue starvation.

bench-bot: [automation] bench-queue status: available_quota=35, running=4, pending=10

zara: API surface for this gate? intake should return status: ACCEPTED | PENDING-BENCH | BLOCKED | CANARY. plus a reason code.

liam: sample status payload idea:

```
status: PENDING-BENCH
reason: LONG_TAIL_DRIFT
release_action: SCHEDULED-BENCH-2026-05-03T02:00Z
```

theo: we also need a programmatic hook so rollout service can pause/resume. emit a compact event to svc-rollout with model_id, status, score, and failing_bucket. keep it tiny.

yuki: security/compliance: private deployments may want to skip cloud telemetry. make gate pluggable: local telemetry adapter vs cloud.

rob: agree. implement adapter interface early. default to cloud for hosted, local for private.

zara: lastly, failure-mode test plan: write simulated regressions (abi, golden, perf) and ensure gate transitions as expected. add chaos tests where bench infra is slow.

liam: will draft RFC: includes reservoir rotation rules, hysteresis timers, compact schema, API payloads, and test plan. volunteers to review? zara, theo?

zara: happy to.

theo: in.

bench-bot: [info] note: last_week_bench_runs=128
